title_zh_tw: S5 發布規則追溯矩陣
scope_zh_tw: 本檔只追溯 S5 發布整合的五項驗收規則，不是全部現行規則清單；現行入口、順序與權威層級以 INSTALL.md 為準。
scope_en: This file traces five S5 release-integration checks only; it is not an exhaustive active-rule catalog. INSTALL.md governs the current entrypoint, sequence, and authority order.

rules.requirement_zh_tw: 讀者版先有唯一今日總覽，再依台灣、中國、世界順序輸出單項新聞。
rules.requirement_en: The reader begins with one Today Overview, followed by per-story Taiwan, China, and World sections.
rules.legacy_status: retired: field-based 逐條詳報/後續觀察; retained: per-story title/image/summary/grade/source layout

rules.requirement_zh_tw: 圖片只能位於所屬新聞內，依地圖、資料圖表、圖一、圖二直向排列，圖說緊接且不得疊圖。
rules.requirement_en: Images stay inside their owning story, vertically ordered after maps/charts, with adjacent numbered captions and no overlap.

rules.requirement_zh_tw: 每張來源圖必須有不同於文章頁的實際圖片網址，且出現在來源頁檢查結果中。
rules.requirement_en: Every source image has a media URL distinct from the article URL and present in that page's inspection evidence.
rules.legacy_status: retired: self-made text card as source image

rules.requirement_zh_tw: 發布器重算圖片 SHA-256、尺寸，並核對 canonical materializer ready 紀錄。
rules.requirement_en: The publisher recomputes image SHA-256 and dimensions and matches the canonical materializer ready record.

rules.requirement_zh_tw: GitHub run bundle 必須保存可重算候選稽核、逐列 dispositions、圖片證據與 materializer manifest，並原子更新 current.json。
rules.requirement_en: The GitHub run bundle preserves recomputable candidate audit, row dispositions, image evidence, and materializer manifest, then atomically updates current.json.
rules.producer: scripts/manage_canonical_run_bundle.py pack; connector uploads encoding=base64 records and publishes one atomic tree/commit
rules.validator: scripts/manage_canonical_run_bundle.py verify/restore; S5 requires storage.mode=chunked reconstruction and byte identity
